<b>Claw Mirror</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It damages enemies after casting [[Bind]].

After acquiring the <b>Dark Mirror</b> in [[Act 3]], they combine into the <b>Claw Mirrors</b>, extending its effect.

== Usefulness ==
<b>Claw Mirror</b> deals 11 base damage (scales with [[Tool Pouch & Crafting Kit|Tool Damage]]) around Hornet after using [[Bind]], as well as an area of effect which deals 2 ticks of 5 damage that don't scale.

The <b>Claw Mirrors</b> increase the base damage to 15, with the 2 ticks of extra damage increasing to 8.

Claw Mirrors work well with the [[Witch Crest]] as it increases the overall damage each Bind, allowing for even more aggressive play, though it is possible for the Claw Mirrors' damage to kill an enemy, preventing the thrashes from healing their full amount.

== How To Acquire ==
<b>Claw Mirror</b> is dropped by [[Trobbio]] after defeating him in [[The Stage]].

<b>Dark Mirror</b> is dropped by [[Tormented Trobbio]] after defeating him in [[The Stage]] and is combined with the Claw Mirror to form the <b>Claw Mirrors</b>.

== Trivia == 
* With Claw Mirror or Claw Mirrors equipped, Hornet's [[Bind]] animation is changed to add a twirl before Binding.
** If [[Multibinder]] is also equipped Hornet will twirl twice, ending up facing the opposite direction from when she started the Bind.
** [[Beast Crest]], [[Shaman Crest]], and [[Witch Crest]] are not affected, as they have unique Bind animations.
* It is impossible to obtain the Dark Mirror on its own, since it is not actually an item and only upgrades the Claw Mirror, which is also a pre-requisite for accessing the [[Wish]] <i>[[Pain, Anguish and Misery]]</i> in the first place. If the game is modified to be able to fight [[Tormented Trobbio]] without having the Claw Mirror, he will then drop both items and [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] will pick them up in normal succession.
